notes.title: V2.5
notes.content:
1. Increase civilians' ability to hide in morphing vehicles to improve survival

2. Fixed a bug where the character's death diamond might reset when protecting civilians from crossing the level

3. Fixed a bug where flying mechs could fall into the ground when deformed

notes.title: Doomsdayhero 2.0 major update
Improve and optimize the game, fix bugs
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where enemy ranged attack weapons would sometimes drop health without touching them
2. Increases the duration of gold coins. Drops are set to not disappear
3. Fixed a bug where enemies' burning status would attack
4. Increase the number of waves showing the enemy's attack, and make the clearance more targeted
5. Adjust part of the UI layout
6. PUBG mode increases enemy level display per wave
7. Modify and switch weapon operation bits
